$comment: Stack profile — the knobs that differ between projects, so no script hardcodes one stack's
assumptions. Copy this file, fill it in from what your project actually uses, and pass it
with --profile. Deriving it is quick; the steps are in references/stack-profiles.md.
Every regex is a string source (no slashes) and runs without flags unless noted. A null
disables that measure, and a script must report a disabled measure as 'not measured'
rather than as zero — a zero from a rule that cannot match anything is how a check
The values below are deliberately neutral: they find CSS custom properties and hex
literals, which exist everywhere, and nothing that belongs to one framework.
name: base

colour.utilityClassesNote: Tailwind-style text-blue-500 / bg-slate-900. null where the project has no utility-class colour layer — see vue-tailwind.json for the shape.

components.localPrefixesNote: Prefixes that mark a project's own shared components, e.g. ["Sd","Ui"]. Empty disables the used-but-not-imported check rather than guessing.

logicBlock.styleNote: auto detects per file; or force 'vue' (the <script> blocks) or 'whole' (the file is the module, React/plain JS).
